title: Multi3Hate: Multimodal, Multilingual, and Multicultural Hate Speech Detection with Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot vision-language models on a multimodal hate speech dataset and comparing their predictions against ground-truth labels provided by annotators from five different countries (USA, Germany, Mexico, India, China) to measure whether models disproportionately align with US cultural perspectives.

Assessing model performance and alignment on hate speech detection across five different languages (English, German, Spanish, Hindi, Mandarin) by manipulating the language of the input text and prompts to see if language influences cultural alignment.
